name: @yceffort/coldpath
description: Trace which bundled JavaScript executes in real browser scenarios and why it is loaded

scripts.test: cargo test --locked && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:corpus && pnpm test:package
scripts.test:corpus: node scripts/verify-label-score.mjs && node scripts/verify-graphs.mjs && node scripts/verify-corpus.mjs && node scripts/verify-recovery.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/verify.mjs && node scripts/verify-formats.mjs && node scripts/verify-collector.mjs && node scripts/verify-environment.mjs && node scripts/verify-flows.mjs && node scripts/verify-treemap.mjs && node scripts/verify-comparison.mjs && node scripts/verify-inferred.mjs && node scripts/verify-profile.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings bin lib scripts benchmarks examples/demo && oxfmt --check bin lib scripts benchmarks/*.mjs examples/demo
scripts.format: oxfmt bin lib scripts benchmarks/*.mjs examples/demo
